headline: UBS has raised its price target for Microsoft shares to $675 from $525, saying AI demand for its cloud business supports a higher valuation.
score_reason: Routine analyst target change; the market effect is limited, facts support the pool score.
importance_line: Microsoft shareholders and watchers of AI cloud demand get one bank's expectation ahead of results, which is an analyst view, not a finding, and not advice.
summary: Proactive Investors, as carried by Yahoo Finance Canada, reports that UBS lifted its Microsoft target ahead of the company's 28 Oct 2026 results, citing strong enterprise demand and rising AI infrastructure spending for Azure, Microsoft's cloud computing business. UBS says the market expects Azure growth of 47%, and warns that after a 39% rally higher expectations leave less room for disappointment.
notes: Pool source Yahoo! Finance Canada; the page's own metadata names Proactive Investors as the provider, so Proactive is credited. Original Proactive link not found; the Yahoo page is where the text was read.
